# Forecasting Memory — FINAL (sim ended 2026-06-28)

## FINAL RESULT: TW-Score 3948.6 over 378 questions (~+10.4/q avg). BSS 0.110. Accuracy 23.3%.

## TOP LESSONS FOR FUTURE RUNS
1. Daily reveal-monitoring is the #1 lever: hidden-event questions resolve from future articles; catching reveals early (Burnham, Sindarov, Iraq PM, Peru runoff, Hungary polls, Fury) = biggest wins. Sweep election results within 48h.
2. NAME MATCHING: submit fullest news-style form ("Laura Fernandez Delgado", "Sooryavanshi", "Qassam Brigades" not "Hamas", "Turkiye", FIFA venue names, "Chungcheong area" style regions sometimes beat specific cities — consider generic+specific split).
3. Honest small-probability guesses on lotteries are +EV; abstain only with zero signal. Never overbet late reveals without verifying exact wording ("improper conduct" ≠ red card; comeback bout ≠ super-fight; "sources say" caps ~0.35-0.45).
4. Officeholder audit: verify EVERY leader/counterpart as of NOW (Vietnam PM trap -56). Dead people can't lead delegations (Larijani, Khamenei).
5. Question text leaks info: location hints (Kiryat Arba→Strock), numbers (281→Jordan transit), ambient storylines (Cuba crisis→Trump Cuba; Mojtaba thanks Iraq→Hormuz exemption).
6. Best structural bets: incumbents/favorites at fair odds (Carrick .60→+83.5, Al-Nassr .60→+78.8, Marcos +68, Starmer +60, Haaland +61.8, SGA +65.9); 2-way near-splits when truly uncertain (Collins/Murkowski, MIN/DEN, FTC/DOJ paid).
